analysis:
This PR is documentation-only: it moves the retained console UI (console-ui) out of this repo's scope and into the platform repo. I examined the three changed files.

- docs/reference/configuration.md: the visible head text (lines 474-734) is unchanged provider/native-runtime env var documentation. The patch excerpt shows the intro rewording (lines 5-7 head) and removal of the 'Console UI' section (base 81-99) with its NEXT_PUBLIC_* variable table. The removed text only documented build-time public variables and warned against placing private credentials in NEXT_PUBLIC_* values, so it is documentation removal, not a control change. No provider env var defaults, gates or forwarding statements are visible as changed in the supplied head range. The excerpt is truncated, so I could not see the full removed section.
- docs/reference/provider-authorization.md: the date is bumped, and the console-ui copy reference is replaced with an immutable pinned platform link (commit 48a198c7...). The substantive claims are unchanged: App Attest and legacy evidence remain independent, basic serving is separate from receipt monitoring, and removal readiness needs a fresh snapshot of at most 10 s. This aligns with the T-052/T-053/T-054/T-057 documentation. No weakening of authorization semantics was identified.
- docs/reference/telemetry-schema.md: the TypeScript mirror is reclassified as an external platform contract with an immutable link, and local checks are stated not to certify its live compatibility. No telemetry schema fields changed.

No code, endpoint, key custody, cache encryption (T-041) or fan-helper (TB-010) behavior changed, so I identified no security regression or invalidated assumption. Remaining uncertainty is limited to external platform content behind the pinned links, which I did not verify and which is out of scope; the docs themselves state it is evidence rather than current policy.
